image_description: A close-up, slightly low-angle shot of an antique aneroid barometer. The instrument features a circular dial with a brass or gold-toned bezel and a glass cover. The face is off-white/cream with black numerical markings (likely inches of mercury) and weather condition text ('Change', 'Rain', etc.). Two hands are visible: a long black indicator hand and a shorter reference hand. The background is dark and textured, possibly wood paneling.
